annotations.kubernetes.io/description: Contains a CA bundle that can be used to verify the kube-apiserver when using internal endpoints such as the internal service IP or kubernetes.default.svc. No other usage is guaranteed across distributions of Kubernetes clusters.

containers.name: postgres
command:
until [ -f /vault/secrets/config ]; do
  echo "Waiting for Vault Agent..."
  sleep 2
done
source /vault/secrets/config
exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres

annotations.vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject-templat:
{{- with secret "secret/data/n8n" -}}
export DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE="{{ .Data.data.POSTGRES_DB }}"
export DB_POSTGRESDB_USER="{{ .Data.data.POSTGRES_USER }}"
export DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD="{{ .Data.data.POSTGRES_PASSWORD }}"
export N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY="{{ .Data.data.ENCRYPTION_KEY }}"
export N8N_USER_MANAGEMENT_JWT_SECRET="{{ .Data.data.JWT_SECRET }}"
{{- end }}

containers.name: n8n
command:
until [ -f /vault/secrets/config ]; do
  echo "Waiting for Vault Agent to inject secrets..."
  sleep 2
done
source /vault/secrets/config
exec n8n start

annotations.vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject-templat:
{{- with secret "secret/data/mautic" -}}
export MAUTIC_DB_NAME="{{ .Data.data.MYSQL_DB }}"
export MAUTIC_DB_USER="{{ .Data.data.MYSQL_USER }}"
export MAUTIC_DB_PASSWORD="{{ .Data.data.MYSQL_PASSWORD }}"
export MAUTIC_ADMIN_EMAIL="{{ .Data.data.ADMIN_EMAIL }}"
export MAUTIC_ADMIN_USERNAME="{{ .Data.data.ADMIN_USERNAME }}"
export MAUTIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD="{{ .Data.data.ADMIN_PASSWORD }}"
{{- end }}

containers.name: mautic
command:
source /vault/secrets/config
export MAUTIC_DB_NAME=$MAUTIC_DB_NAME
export MAUTIC_DB_USER=$MAUTIC_DB_USER
export MAUTIC_DB_PASSWORD=$MAUTIC_DB_PASSWORD
export MAUTIC_ADMIN_EMAIL=$MAUTIC_ADMIN_EMAIL
export MAUTIC_ADMIN_USERNAME=$MAUTIC_ADMIN_USERNAME
export MAUTIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD=$MAUTIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD
exec /entrypoint.sh

containers.name: odoo
command:
until [ -f /vault/secrets/config ]; do
  echo "Waiting for Vault Agent to inject config file..."
  sleep 2
done
exec odoo --config /vault/secrets/config \
  -i base,web,mail,account,account_accountant,sale_management,\
purchase,stock,mrp,project,crm,hr,hr_payroll,hr_expense,\
hr_holidays,fleet,maintenance,helpdesk,timesheet,\
website,ecommerce,point_of_sale,inventory \
  -d odoo_prod

export WORDPRESS_NONCE_KEY="{{ .Data.data.WORDPRESS_NONCE_KEY }}"
export WORDPRESS_AUTH_SALT="{{ .Data.data.WORDPRESS_AUTH_SALT }}"
export WORDPRESS_SECURE_AUTH_SALT="{{ .Data.data.WORDPRESS_SECURE_AUTH_SALT }}"
export WORDPRESS_LOGGED_IN_SALT="{{ .Data.data.WORDPRESS_LOGGED_IN_SALT }}"
